preconditions.description: The number of commands N is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(line) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each command line has a length between 1 and 100 characters inclusive.
Each command line ends with a period.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(' ' + line[11:] + '\n' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.startswith('Simon says '))
postconditions.description: The output contains only the commands that start with 'Simon says', with 'Simon says' removed and a leading space added, each followed by a newline.
